title: Install or recover the Chancery reader
summary: Select a tested user-owned macOS Chancery release, verify its matching bundle and selectors, register its commands, or recover a verified retained release.
use_when: The Chancery reader must be installed, upgraded, inspected, verified, or recovered.
do_not_use_when: Another product must be deployed or its provider selector repaired.
The caller needs to alter or delete usage history.
outcome: The intended tested Chancery program and matching bundle are coherently selected and verified, with other provider selectors and journal history preserved.
effects: Stages and selects a content-addressed current-user program release with matching documentation.
Changes only owned command, installer, current/previous, and Chancery provider selectors.
Post-install registration separately initializes only an empty supported journal and adds command identities.
authority: Chancery owns its reader installation and provider selector. Each other product owns its release and selector.
The tested installer and installed checks establish selection; catalog discovery does not prove represented readiness.
success: The installer verifies the intended current release and matching bundle; installed version, product, list, show, resolve, and doctor reports preserve their separate meanings.
Other provider selectors and usage history remain intact, and registration has an explicit outcome.
failure_and_recovery: Stop on a foreign selector, invalid candidate, failed integrity check, or unsupported existing installation.
Use a trusted tested installer to verify and recover the canonical owned retained release; never execute an unverified retained installer.
privacy: Install public local documentation without secrets. The separate private journal retains only command identity, thread, and observation time.
does_not_authorize: Changing another product release or provider selector.
Executing represented capabilities, clearing usage history, or editing installed immutable releases.
steps: Identify and validate the tested binary, matching installer, and reviewed bundle.
Inspect and capture the owned current selection; verify the candidate before selection.
Install the intended candidate and explicitly register its command inventory.
Confirm matching installed program and documentation with preserved other selectors.
Verify and recover only an exact canonical owned retained release when recovery is required.
checkpoints: The candidate is tested and the bundle validates before selection.
Existing selectors are owned and any expected-current guard matches the captured selection.
Installed selection and post-install registration have separately verified outcomes.
adaptation: Use absolute tested paths and the intended user-home override when an isolated installation is required.
Treat doctor issues as provider-owned diagnostics rather than assuming all are reader installation failures.
stop_when: A selector has a foreign target or the candidate/retained release fails integrity verification.
The intended tested release or supported installation cannot be identified.
Journal registration fails because state is unsupported; do not recreate it.

consumers.statement: Current-user macOS operators may install, inspect, verify, or recover the Chancery reader.

preconditions.statement: A tested binary, matching trusted tested installer, reviewed bundle, and owned target installation are available. Nucleus health and authentication are not required.

inputs.statement: Absolute candidate binary and bundle paths or an exact canonical owned retained release; optional absolute user-home override and exact expected-current guard.

outputs.statement: Verified intended program and bundle selection, retained other provider selectors and history, and explicit command-registration outcome.

data_semantics.statement: Reader installation selects documentary artifacts only. A catalog issue, compatibility result, registration result, and represented live readiness have distinct meanings.

identity_and_units.statement: Release identity is content-addressed; current and previous select exact releases. Expected-current is absent or releases/HASH. The bundle provider release and entry contract versions remain independent.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Verification covers the selected release inventory, owned selectors, and installed documentation at the inspection boundary. The procedure promises no live represented-product probe.

access.statement: The current-user macOS installer modifies only its owned installation and selectors and rejects foreign targets. Optional --home selects an explicit user home.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Installation stages a release and advances program and provider selectors coherently with rollback support. Recovery validates an exact retained owned release before selecting it. The journal and other providers remain preserved.

operational_limits.statement: No service or schedule is installed. Stop on invalid bundles, integrity failures, foreign ownership, or unsupported state; source presence is not candidate proof.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Bundle publication deploys compatible reader support first. Current cell-install-v2 exact inventory and verified supported legacy layouts remain distinct. Program recovery does not erase usage observations.

reliances.statement: This attended current-user operation uses local owned artifacts and creates no reliance on represented product runtime, network services, or Nucleus readiness.
